title: Mary-san/Teketeke
overview: The ringing of the phone echoes through a high-rise building late at night. The voice on the other end introduces herself as Mary-san. Shizuka is pursued by her via every phone call, no matter the room she flees to or the hallway she runs down. What encounter awaits Mary-san after cornering Shizuka?! Teketeke a wandering spirit that seeks after its lower half of the body, lost in an accident. Shizuka, who was forced to listen to the story from Kamui, finds the ghost before her 'as promised,' unaware that this was a clever trap set up by Kamui.

title: Kokkuri-san
overview: Hiding her psychic ability, Shizuka hopes to enjoy school life as an ordinary student. However, her peace is shattered through her friend, Inagawa, who brings in a Kokkuri-san sheet. A spirit appears in response to Inagawa and the others' summons, and its evil grasp closes in on Shizuka. Can Kamui fulfill Shizuka's request to perform an exorcism 'secretly, without anyone seeing'?

title: The Cursed Doll / The Gap Woman
overview: A cursed checkered doll that keeps returning no matter how many times it's disposed of is brought into Kamui's office. The doll challenges Kamui to take her on in the purification ritual. But there, she witnesses Kamui's unimaginable lifeforce and exorcism methods firsthand. While searching for a girl who's been spirited away, Shizuka is captured by the Gap Woman. Will Kamui be able to rescue Shizuka who's trapped in a narrow gap of a building where she is out of reach?

title: The Slit-Mouthed Woman / Rokurokubi
overview: Shizuka is forced into a elementary school costume—tight-fitting clothes and a school backpack. As she grieves over the random punishment, the Slit-Mouthed Woman presses her, asking if she looks pretty. Shizuka flees to the empty school after classes. What is Kamui's secret plan, waiting for her in the infirmary? Kamui receives a message from Shizuka that she's going to hang out with her best friend Kyoko, and upon seeing the attached photo, he senses something. Will Shizuka be able to hide Kamui's exorcism from Kyoko?!

title: Bakeneko
overview: Oichi, the cursed Ichimatsu doll who was defeated in her battle against the Slit-Mouthed Woman, gets picked up by a young girl named Yui and becomes her cherished playmate. Then, a black cat that Yui had found joins them as a new playmate. But that cat was no ordinary black cat! With Yui's life and the top spot of playmate on the line, the battle between Oichi and the black cat begins!

title: The Mountain Pass Spirit / Jet Babaa
overview: Shizuka, who has gone for a drive with Kamui, picks up a soaking-wet woman along the mountain pass at night. Eerie handprints appear on the fogged-up windows, and the sound of the car creaking begins to echo from outside. A night of terror begins! Showing off her youth in a tight bikini as she sits in the driver's seat, Shizuka is pursued by the Jet Hag Gang—the mountain pass's supernatural menace! Oichi's driving skills and Kamui's techniques explode onto the nighttime mountain pass!

title: Hanako-san of the Toilet
overview: The ghostly phenomenon of the girl Hanako-san is haunting elementary schools all over Japan. Kamui and Shizuka join forces to exorcise them all at once. As their friends are exorcised one after another, the Hanako-san from all over Japan panic, and they gather at an abandoned school deep in the mountains. What is the desperate plan they have devised to turn the tide?!

title: The Succubus
overview: A voluptuous mother and her cute daughter visit the office from abroad. When the mother asks Kamui to exorcise the succubus possessing her, Kamui suddenly rips her clothes off! He kicks a flustered Shizuka out of the room and begins the exorcism. Will Shizuka merely stand by and watch Kamui's battle, which could potentially become an international incident?

title: Resurrection
overview: After being ambushed by a succubus and having his life force completely drained, Kamui naturally (?) falls into Hell. However, declaring that he has business to get down to, Kamui aims to return to the living world and confronts Enma the Great, who enforces the rules of the underworld. Meanwhile, in the living world, the creature Fire Cart attempts to possess Kamui's lifeless body. Will Shizuka and Oichi be able to protect Kamui's body from getting taken over?

title: Takaonna / Yamamba
overview: A mysterious beauty named Lily Kiskil transfers to Shizuka's school. Shizuka feels as if she's met Lily somewhere before, but Lily presses forward relentlessly. Then, a supernatural phenomenon attacks them without mercy. Shizuka, who longs for an ordinary school life but finds that the abnormal is becoming the norm, and Kamui, who has gone into training to gain greater power, cross paths in the mountains!
